n_aaf4e784696c8b30.name: Prepare the poetry URL
n_aaf4e784696c8b30.source: export default function hop({initialUrl,previousState}) {const candidate=previousState?.nextUrl||initialUrl;let url;try{url=new URL(candidate)}catch{throw Error('Configure a valid HTTP or HTTPS target URL')}if(!['http:','https:'].includes(url.protocol)||url.username||url.password)throw Error('Configure an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials');return{url:url.toString()};}

n_d50909875fac843b.name: Read the poem
n_d50909875fac843b.source: export default function check({url,statusCode,headers,body,previousState}){const hops=previousState?.hops??0;if(!Number.isInteger(statusCode)||statusCode<100||statusCode>599||!Number.isInteger(hops)||hops<0)throw Error('Invalid response');if(statusCode>=300&&statusCode<400&&typeof headers?.location==='string'&&headers.location){if(hops>=21)throw Error('Too many redirects');let target;try{target=new URL(headers.location,url)}catch{throw Error('Invalid redirect')}if(!['http:','https:'].includes(target.protocol)||target.username||target.password)throw Error('Invalid redirect');return{state:{hops:hops+1,nextUrl:target.toString()},redirect:true,text:'redirect',title:'redirect',author:'redirect'}}if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300)throw Error('Poetry request failed');let result;try{result=JSON.parse(body)}catch{throw Error('Invalid poetry JSON')}const p=result?.data;if(typeof p?.title!=='string'||!p.title.trim()||typeof p?.author?.name!=='string'||!p.author.name.trim()||!Array.isArray(p.content)||!p.content.length||p.content.some(x=>typeof x!=='string')||!p.content.join('').trim())throw Error('Poetry response is missing a title, author or content');return{state:{hops,nextUrl:''},redirect:false,text:p.content.join('\n'),title:p.title,author:p.author.name}}
